topic: In-game HUD art assets: exhaustive inventory of png/ui, retail loaders, dimensions, consumers, missing/dead assets, and quality variants

findings.claim: The retail HUD texture root is png/ui: run.py sets `pyglet.resource.path = ['png/ui']` before reindexing, so every images.py/image.load name list is resolved relative to png/ui.
findings.citation: G:/AoSRevival/aceofspades_source/aoslib/run.py:151-154

findings.claim: low/med/high are NOT HUD variants. TEXTURE_QUALITY_PATHS = {0:'png/low', 1:'png/med', 2:'png/high'} and that directory is only prefixed when add_path=True; every HUD/UI load in images.py passes add_path=False (default), so all HUD art comes from png/ui at one authored size.
findings.citation: G:/AoSRevival/aceofspades_source/aoslib/image.py:12-14 and get_image_path at aoslib/image.py:37-49

findings.claim: The only textures that use the low/med/high tiers are the 31 world/particle/skybox images (block128, tumbling_cube_lut, Tumbling_Glowcube_anim_8x8, Tumbling_cube_anim, SmokeTrail_anim_8x8, particle_lut, PickUp_Twinkle_anim_4x4, SnowkeTrail_anim_8x8 plus skybox/laser/smoke/tile/white/alpha_block), loaded with add_path=True.
findings.citation: G:/AoSRevival/aceofspades_source/aoslib/images.py:905-921 (load_particle_textures) and aoslib/weapons/laserAttachment.py:83-84

findings.claim: The three quality dirs are pure mip ladders: e.g. block128.png is 32x32 (low) / 64x64 (med) / 128x128 (high); white.png is 1x1 / 2x2 / 4x4; skybox_bw.png is 512x256 / 1024x512 / 2048x1024. laser_spot.png and laser_sight_beam_small.png are the only two identical across all three tiers.
findings.citation: PNG IHDR of assets/original/png/{low,med,high}/*.png

findings.claim: The client picks the tier from config 'texture_quality', default 1 (= png/med); the value is clamped to 0..2 and appended to pyglet.resource.path by set_texture_quality.

I identified the functions but did not decompile their arithmetic; the numbers should be recovered from those functions or from retail screenshot parity, not guessed.

The numeric values of the TC_HUD_* and HC_* layout constants (TC_HUD_BASE_SIZE, TC_HUD_BASE_X_INTERVAL, TC_HUD_LETTER_SCALE, TC_HUD_LETTER_XOFF/YOFF, TC_HUD_PLATE_XOFF/YOFF, TC_HUD_ICON_SCALE, TC_HUD_X_FROM_SCREEN_LEFT, TC_HUD_Y_FROM_SCREEN_TOP, TC_PULSE_TIME, HC_FRAME_WIDTH, HC_TEXT_WIDTH*, HC_TIMER_WIDTH). Only the identifier strings survive in hud.pyd's string table; the float/int values sit in the module-init constant blobs and were not resolved.

Which minimap marker maps to which entity type for the gameScene.pyd-loaded set (map_base_16, map_pickup_16, marker_medpack_16, marker_radar_station_16, marker_c4_16, marker_dynamite_16, marker_land_mine_16). The filenames make the pairing obvious but the actual entity-class -> icon binding is inside gameScene.pyd and was not decompiled; only rocketTurret/bomb/diamond/intel are proven from shipped .py.
